status_definition.eligible_not_retained: Passes reconstructed filters but is absent; historical execution failure or unrecorded exclusion
status_definition.explicit_skip: Named in the benchmark driver's built-in skip list
status_definition.load_error: PMLB entry could not be loaded from the configured cache/source
status_definition.non_finite_value: Input or target contains a non-finite/missing value
status_definition.over_max_product: n_samples * n_features exceeds the active cap
